pbo_interpretation: family_diagnostic_only_not_R9D04_gate; all six partitions selected non-promotable R9D02; 0/6 has a one-sided 95% upper bound near 0.393
trade_count_semantics: aggregate R9D04 cost events including terminal liquidation, not round-trip trades
capacity_assessment: blocked_pending_forward opening-auction volume, spread, order-size, and matched fill evidence; no ADV-based paper authorization is supported by R9
benchmark_finding: The frozen BIL raw-Sharpe hurdle is arithmetically reproducible but methodologically unsuitable as a risky-strategy Sharpe hurdle. It is not changed after results, so the frozen failure stands.
accounting_findings: Reported annualized turnover uses half-L1 convention and understates executed one-way cash-boundary notional.
The simulator applies a pre-cost wealth haircut and is not an exact self-financing transaction solver.
Published ledgers do not provide event-level aggregate-versus-independent-fold cost reconciliation.
artifact_findings: R9 evidence, data, and specs are ignored by Git and are not durable from repository history alone.
The final output set has no immutable self-binding receipt or atomic multi-file publication.
The intraday same-target claim hashes one shared in-memory target object and does not independently bind both arms to candidate and ledger identities.
notes: R9 remains stopped. R9D02 is selection-prohibited historical challenge evidence and may only motivate a separately preregistered forward-only hypothesis.
